Team — quick hygiene sweep ahead of finance forecast lock. I reviewed the Q2 renewal report and flagged ~18 accounts with stale stages or missing commit amounts. We need clean inputs by EOD Friday so FP&A can finalize the renewal number on Monday.

Action items (high priority):
- Please update SFDC Deal Stage + Commit Amount for any account in your book that is in Renewal Outreach / Legal / Procurement. If you don't have a committed ARR, mark the probability and next step.
- For any account you plan to push to "Commit", add a one-line rationale in the Deal Notes field (finance needs the reason).
- Upload any outstanding SOWs/POs to the Drive folder linked below and add the doc link to the deal.

Accounts I'm worried about (from preliminary review):
1) Emerald Health — in Procurement since 2026-03-12, no PO or signed SOW in attachments; renewal target $285k.
2) Stellar Retail — Legal redlines open, pricing re-negotiation requested; risk of 20% shrink.
3) Acme Analytics — technical pilot conversion not confirmed; indicated lower usage.

If you have a formal ask (credits / discount / SLA exception) please escalate to me and Laura this week with the proposed concession and ROI. We will review requests on Friday 11:00am PT.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/renewal-watch-2026-Q2 | HubSpot: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/471

Attaching the watchlist CSV with my flags.

Thanks — Vivek

Got it — thanks for the heads up and the detailed notes. A few quick points from Finance before you mark anything as Commit: 
1) Any concession > $10k or payment term > Net30 requires VP Finance approval. Please submit the Concession Approval Form (I've added the template to the Drive folder) with a short payback justification (ARR impact / renewal likelihood).
2) For forecasting: if a deal is "Pending PO" with documented procurement date and probability <70%, we count it as "At Risk" in the plan, not as Commit. If PO arrives before Monday, we will reclassify in the final sweep.
3) Please ensure the following fields are present on each deal you expect finance to model: Commit Amount, Probability, Expected Close Date, Source of Truth doc link. Missing fields cause us to exclude the deal.

I'll join the Friday 11:00am PT review for final concessions. If you expect Emerald to convert this week and require the $15k implementation credit, Sean — please upload the Concession Approval Form and tag me. Otherwise mark the deal "At Risk" for the forecast.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A | Redwood Inference
